name: Fitness habit
goalText: Build a sustainable three-day weekly strength habit without aggravating an old knee issue.

interviewOutputArtifact.goalSummary: Create a sustainable three-day weekly strength training habit.
interviewOutputArtifact.coreWhy: The user wants more energy and confidence without restarting too aggressively and quitting.
interviewOutputArtifact.successDefinition: Three strength sessions happen each week for four weeks with a simple knee-safe modification log.
interviewOutputArtifact.currentStage: The user walks regularly but has not lifted consistently for years.
safetyBoundaries: Consult a qualified professional for pain or injury concerns
interviewOutputArtifact.compactSourceSummary: The user wants a practical strength habit with equipment, tracking, and cautious knee boundaries.

transcript.content: I want to lift three times a week, but I overdo it and my old knee issue scares me.
What would make this sustainable instead of another restart?
Short home workouts, a tracker, and permission to modify instead of quitting.
